repos_data.description: Free up your Mac. Safely. A free, open-source native Mac app that clears the cache and junk your Mac piles up on its own. Files go to the Trash by default, so you can put them back.
TUI macOS cleaner that scans caches/logs, shows sizes/paths, lets you select what to delete before Trash.
Uninstall Mac apps with every file they leave behind, and see why each belongs. Free up space, fine-tune macOS, and set up Terminal.

Free, open-source disk space analyzer for macOS, inspired by WinDirStat. See what's taking up space on your Mac with an interactive treemap and track down large files. Native SwiftUI app for Apple silicon and Intel, signed and notarized, fully offline.

Free, open-source CleanMyMac alternative for macOS. Preview disk cleanup by path and size, inspect memory by app, and quit idle apps after review. Menu bar app, CLI, Homebrew. No account or telemetry.
面向影视创作者与开发者的 Mac 清理工具。识别 60 余款剪辑、设计与 AI 工具的缓存，一键清理，可撤销，不影响项目、素材与对话。
Free, open-source Mac cleaner. Everything goes to the Trash first; duplicates are checked against your project scripts before removal.
